title: Reflected XSS in search
notes:
Reflected XSS in the search box (GET /search?q=).
The q parameter is echoed unencoded inside the results heading.
Payload <script>alert(document.domain)</script> executes in Chrome and no CSP header is set.
The victim has to open a crafted link.
